acceptance: Each bundled TPC-DS binary is run by a scheduled or path-triggered job (native runner or emulation) and its manifest compared with the reference
description: The TPC-DS platform identity check runs only linux-x86_64, darwin-arm64 and windows-x86_64. The bundled darwin-x86_64, linux-arm64 and windows-arm64 dsdgen/dsqgen binaries are never executed in CI, so a platform-specific generation defect there (like the Windows option-prefix and macOS dbgen bugs found this cycle) would go unnoticed.
